calibration.rule: per candidate, the highest calibration recall with precision >= 0.9 (ties: higher precision, stricter threshold); the candidate with the highest calibration recall at its point (ties: higher precision, candidate order)
calibration.trimmed: a synthetic cut at depth > 0 ms (any of the first letter removed)

owner_check.history: written down before any result: contradicted only when the chosen candidate finds fewer than MIN_OWNER_FLAG_RECALL of the owner's flags; that rule passed the chosen candidate (onset_level_db, calling 99 of 187 exposed items trimmed at owner-check precision 0.18). The precision floor (MIN_PRECISION, the operating point's) was added after that first build; detector-off rests on it.

treatment: an exposed item judged trimmed (by an owner note first, else by the detector where it decides) is onset_trimmed: an excerpt fault, out of every evaluation denominator and training-target export; its verdict stays on record
